shared_elements: horizontal registers/bands separated by ruled dividing lines
rows of small pictographic sign-like motifs (script-like carving)
repeated schematic bird- or plant-like signs within a line
relief/outline rendering of small figures in profile
justification: Both surfaces are organised as horizontal registers of small pictographic sign-forms set between ruled lines, with individual signs (bird-like and plant-like shapes in profile) repeated along a line, which is a reasonably specific shared convention of a written register system. The biggest difference in content is that A carries an entire figural scene at the top — adoring human figures beneath a rayed disc, offering table and flanking cartouches — none of which appears on B, which shows only the banded sign-rows.
